question: storage/datalix-s3-compatible-object-storage carries an evidence row whose url is the placeholder probe:unspecified and which no registered probe record backs, and the record's verdict is qualifies while the read path was never probed. Its product page publishes no S3 endpoint hostname and the vendor's S3-compatible object storage wiki category holds no articles, so the endpoint is only visible in the customer panel. Which record should carry a real read-path probe, and should the placeholder row be dropped once one exists?
why: dropping the placeholder row now would leave a qualifies verdict in storage with no probe row, which the gate fails; an endpoint that only an account shows is unverified behind a sign-up
